claim_text: A general bone-health goal alone does not establish vitamin K deficiency or demonstrate that a vitamin K supplement is indicated; dietary intake, clinical context and anticoagulant interactions must be considered.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsupported or duplicate supplementation and support context-specific assessment.

population.other_context: People selecting bone health as a wellness goal.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify product label and composition.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Vitamin K Health Professional Fact Sheet describes dietary sources, reference intake and warfarin interaction.
limitations: Do not infer osteoporosis prevention or treatment benefit from this general claim.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
